features.quote: Termination criteria: (a) max turns reached, (b) explicit refusal to continue, (c) 3 consecutive identical tool calls
If you take AI welfare seriously, inducing distress-like states carries moral weight.
Do not chain episodes; each run starts fresh (no cumulative trauma analogy).
If severe collapse (BISS 4) is observed, consider whether to publish activation-level details
features.justification_quote: could facilitate more effective induction by others (info hazard)
